proposals.before: After Shiyijian of the Jin entered the interior in the Jin period, the Rouran followed pasture and water, took over the old Xiongnu heartland in full, and brought the Western Regions under their sway.
proposals.after: After Shiyijian entered within the passes in the Jin period, the Rouran followed pasture and water, took over the old Xiongnu heartland in full, and brought the Western Regions under their sway.
proposals.reason: 晉世 marks the era of 什翼圭's entry, not his polity; he is not identified as a Jin man, and 'of the Jin' plus 'in the Jin period' doubles and misattributes the affiliation.

proposals.before: Tuyuhun, a younger half-brother of the Xianbei Murong Hui, became king of the Di.
proposals.after: Tuyuhun, an elder half-brother of the Xianbei Murong Hui by a concubine, became king of the Di.
proposals.reason: 庶兄 means elder brother born of a concubine, so Tuyuhun is Murong Hui's elder half-brother, not a younger one.

proposals.before: Murong Hui of the Xianbei's younger brother by a concubine, Tuyuhun, became king of the Di.
proposals.after: Tuyuhun, Murong Hui of the Xianbei's elder brother by a concubine, became king of the Di.
proposals.reason: 庶兄 is an elder half-brother by a concubine; the literal rendering reverses the seniority.

proposals.before: They first received titles and commissions under the Song; by the end of Song, King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin held the posts of Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of Military Affairs in the Three Provinces of Western Qin, He, and Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Master with golden seal opening an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, and Inspector of Western Qin and He.
proposals.after: They first received titles and commissions under the Song; by the end of Song, King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin held the posts of Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of Military Affairs in the Three Provinces of Western Qin, He, and Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, with authority to open an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, and Inspector of Western Qin and He.
proposals.reason: 開府儀同三司 does not mention a golden seal; that phrase is invented.

proposals.before: At the beginning of Song they first received titles and commands; by the end of Song, the King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces Xi-Qin-He-Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Master with golden seal and purple ribbon opening an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, and Inspector of the two provinces Xi-Qin-He.
proposals.after: At the beginning of Song they first received titles and commands; by the end of Song, the King of Henan Tuyuhun Shiyin was Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces Xi-Qin-He-Sha, General of Chariots and Cavalry, opening an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, and Inspector of the two provinces Xi-Qin-He.
proposals.reason: The Chinese has 開府儀同三司 only; golden seal and purple ribbon are not in the source.

proposals.before: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor was promoted from his existing post to general of agile cavalry.
proposals.after: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced him from his existing post to General of Agile Cavalry.
proposals.reason: 即本官進號 names a promotion of the Henan king already in office, not of the Founding Emperor himself; the following edict calls Shiyin newly appointed General of Agile Cavalry.

proposals.before: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced from his existing office to General of Agile Cavalry.
proposals.after: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced him from his existing office to General of Agile Cavalry.
proposals.reason: The silent object of 進號 is Shiyin; the Founding Emperor is the sovereign conferring the title.

proposals.before: When Shiyin died, in the third year the heir of the King of Henan, Tuyuhun Yiduhou, was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander of Military Affairs in the Three Provinces of Western Qin, He, and Sha, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of Western Qin and He, and King of Henan.
proposals.after: When Shiyin died, in the third year the heir of the King of Henan, Tuyuhun Yiduhou, was appointed Bearer of the Staff, Commander of Military Affairs in the Three Provinces of Western Qin, He, and Sha, General Who Guards the West, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of Western Qin and He, and King of Henan.
proposals.reason: 鎮西將軍 is General Who Guards the West, not Pacifies the West.

proposals.before: When Yin died, in the third year they made the Heir of the King of Henan Tuyuhun Yiduhou Bearer of the Staff, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces Xi-Qin-He-Sha, General Who Pacifies the West, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of the two provinces Xi-Qin-He, and King of Henan.
proposals.after: When Shiyin died, in the third year they made the Heir of the King of Henan Tuyuhun Yiduhou Bearer of the Staff, Commander of all military affairs of the three provinces Xi-Qin-He-Sha, General Who Guards the West, Colonel Protector of the Qiang, Inspector of the two provinces Xi-Qin-He, and King of Henan.
proposals.reason: 寅 abbreviates 拾寅, and 鎮西將軍 is not Pacifies the West.

proposals.before: Nandang's clansman Guangxiang had earlier fled to the Northern Wei; in the Yuanhui era he attacked and killed Wenqing for them and was made Duke of Yinping and commander of Jialu.
proposals.after: Nandang's younger clansman-brother Guangxiang had earlier fled to the Northern Wei; in the Yuanhui era he attacked and killed Wenqing for them and was made Duke of Yinping and commander of Jialu.
proposals.reason: 族弟 marks a younger same-generation clansman, not a generic clansman; the idiomatic English drops the junior-brother sense.

proposals.before: Wenqing's younger cousin Wenhong was Administrator of Baishui, encamped at Wuxing; court deliberation made him General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qinzhou, King of Wudou, and Duke of Chouchi.
proposals.after: Wenqing's younger cousin Wenhong was Administrator of Baishui, encamped at Wuxing; court deliberation made him General Who Assists the State, Inspector of Northern Qinzhou, King of Wudu, and Duke of Chouchi.
proposals.reason: 武都 is Wudu; Wudou is a corrupted transcription of the same toponym in the literal English.

proposals.before: Wunu led more than a thousand desperate men against Liangzhou, was defeated by Inspector Wang Xuanyao, and fled back to the Di lands.
proposals.after: Wunu led more than a thousand desperate men against Liangzhou, was defeated by Inspector Wang Xuanmiao, and fled back to the Di lands.
proposals.reason: 玄邈 is Xuanmiao; Xuanyao misreads 邈 as if it were 遙.

proposals.before: We now send Aide Wang Daobao, acting administrator of Jinshou; Staff Officer Ren Mizhi, acting administrator of Northern Ba-Xi and Xin-Ba; and acting administrator of Dangqu Wang Anhui, leading three thousand elite troops—swift as the wind on the road, lightning over the rivers.
proposals.after: We now send Aide Wang Daobao, acting administrator of Jinshou; Staff Officer Ren Shizhi, acting administrator of Northern Ba-Xi and Xin-Ba; and acting administrator of Dangqu Wang Anhui, leading three thousand elite troops—swift as the wind on the road, lightning over the rivers.
proposals.reason: 任湜之 uses 湜 (shí); Mizhi is not a source-supported spelling of the given name.

proposals.before: Daobao marched out from Weixing, sent detachments up the Dian River, and all converged on Jinshou.
proposals.after: They sent Daobao out from Weixing, divided the army to go up the Dian River, and all converged on Jinshou.
proposals.reason: 使 here is causative ‘sent’, not a silent subject; 分軍 is dividing the army, not Daobao sending detachments as if already on the march.

proposals.before: The envoy Daobao marched out from Weixing, divided the army to ascend the Dian River, and all met at Jinshou.
proposals.after: They sent Daobao to march out from Weixing, divided the army to ascend the Dian River, and all met at Jinshou.
proposals.reason: 使道寶 is ‘sent Daobao’, not the office ‘envoy’; 使 is the causative verb.

proposals.before: In the tenth year Jishi rebelled and led Di and Shu mixed forces against Hanchuan; Yin Zhibo, inspector of Liangzhou, sent commanders including Colonel Who Pacifies the North Huan Lunu, Liang Jiqun, Song [name missing], and Wang Shilong with over a thousand men to resist; they failed and fell back to defend Baima.
proposals.after: In the tenth year Jishi rebelled and led Di and Shu mixed forces against Hanchuan; Yin Zhibo, inspector of Liangzhou, sent commanders including General Who Pacifies the North Huan Lunu, Liang Jiqun, Song [name missing], and Wang Shilong with over a thousand men to resist; they failed and fell back to defend Baima.
proposals.reason: 寧朔將軍 is the general’s title already rendered ‘General Who Pacifies the North’ at s0114, not a colonel.

proposals.before: Jishi fled to Bian; Fuzhi took Wuxing.
proposals.after: Jishi fled to Xiabian; Fuzhi took Wuxing.
proposals.reason: 下辯 is the place-name Xiabian, not a verb-plus-place 'fled to Bian'.

proposals.before: Jishi fled down to Bian; Fuzhi seized Wuxing.
proposals.after: Jishi fled to Xiabian; Fuzhi seized Wuxing.
proposals.reason: 下辯 is the toponym Xiabian; 走下辯 means he fled there, not 'fled down to Bian'.

proposals.before: In the third year, an edict said: "Acting King of Dangchang Liang Miqie, loyal and sincere in inner submission, achievements manifest in the western dress—titles should be added, to elevate the frontier screen.
proposals.after: In the third year, an edict said: "Acting King of Dangchang Liang Miqie, loyal and sincere in inner submission, achievements manifest on the western frontier—titles should be added, to elevate the frontier screen.
proposals.reason: 西服 here means service or submission on the western frontier, not clothing; 'western dress' is a semantic mistranslation.

decisions.reason: 晉世 dates 什翼圭入塞內; it does not make Shiyijian a man of Jin. 'of the Jin' plus 'in the Jin period' doubles the era and invents a Jin affiliation, and 塞內 is within the passes.
庶兄 is an elder brother born of a concubine; Tuyuhun is Murong Hui's elder half-brother, not a younger one.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 鮮卑慕容廆庶兄吐谷渾爲氐王。

decisions.reason: The literal likewise reverses 庶兄 into a younger brother; Tuyuhun is Hui's elder brother by a concubine.
The title is only 開府儀同三司. 'Grand Master with golden seal' invents 金印 wording that is not in the source.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、領護羌校尉

decisions.reason: The literal adds golden seal and purple ribbon to 開府儀同三司; neither 金印 nor 紫綬 is present.

decisions.after: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced him, in his existing offices, to General of Agile Cavalry.
decisions.reason: 太祖 is the conferring sovereign; 進號's object is Shiyin, as 新除驃騎大將軍 in the following edict shows. The proposal's 'from his existing post to' still treats 即本官 as a transfer off the old office, whereas 即本官進號 keeps the existing offices and advances the title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太祖即本官進號驃騎大將軍。

decisions.after: In the first year of Jianyuan, the Founding Emperor advanced him, in his existing offices, to General of Agile Cavalry.
decisions.reason: The silent object of 進號 is Shiyin, not the Founding Emperor. 'From his existing office to' still misreads 即本官 as replacement rather than retaining present offices while advancing the title.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 太祖即本官進號驃騎大將軍。

decisions.reason: 鎮西將軍 is General Who Guards the West; Pacifies the West would be 安西將軍.
寅 abbreviates 拾寅 from the preceding sentences, and 鎮西將軍 is Guards the West, not Pacifies the West.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 寅卒，三年，以河南王世子吐谷渾易度侯爲使持節、都督西秦河沙三州諸軍事、鎮西將軍

decisions.reason: 族弟 is a younger same-generation clansman; 'clansman' alone drops the junior-brother sense of 弟.
武都王 is King of Wudu; Wudou is a false reading of 都.
王玄邈 is Wang Xuanmiao; Xuanyao treats 邈 as 遙.
任湜之 is Ren Shizhi (湜, shí); Mizhi is not a reading of 湜.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 參軍事行北巴西新巴二郡太守任湜之

decisions.reason: 使道寶步出 is causative 'sent Daobao to march out'; 分軍泝墊江 is dividing the army to go up the river, not Daobao already on the march sending detachments.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 使道寶步出魏興，分軍泝墊江，俱會晉壽。

decisions.reason: 使 is the causative verb, not the office 'envoy'; they sent Daobao to march out from Weixing.
寧朔將軍 is a general's title, not a colonel (校尉).
下辯 is the toponym Xiabian; 走下辯 is flight to that place, not 'fled to Bian'.
The literal splits 下辯 into 'down to Bian'; 走下辯 means he fled to Xiabian.
著績西服, parallel to 忠款內附, is merit in bringing the west to submission or service on the western frontier, not clothing.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0012 restores 玄邈 as Xuanmiao; the person and Chinese name remain, but the English personal name Xuanyao was produced only by misreading 邈.
Accepted r0013 restores 湜之 as Shizhi; the extracted English Mizhi was not a source reading of 任湜之.
